fixed_statement:
Use the assumptions and notation of Proposition 9.

\[
\int_{B_0}\int_{z_y}\sigma_1^{-2}\,dA\,dy
=
\int_{F^{-1}(B_0)\cap\{\operatorname{rank}dF=2\}}
\sigma_1^{-2}J_2F\,dx.
\]
fixed_proof:
Define
\[
\widetilde g(x)
=
\sigma_1(x)^{-2}\,
\mathbf 1_{F^{-1}(B_0)\cap\{\operatorname{rank}dF=2\}}(x).
\]
For \(M>0\), set \(g_M=\min\{\widetilde g,M\}\).
By the coarea formula,
\[
\int_{B_0}\int_{z_y} g_M\,dA\,dy
=
\int_{F^{-1}(B_0)}g_M\,J_2F\,dx.
\]
Letting \(M\to\infty\) and using monotone convergence gives the displayed identity.
